title: Grog
summary: GROG, noun A mixture of spirit and water not sweetened. GROG'-BLOSSOM, noun A rum bud; a redness on the nose or face of men who drink ardent spirits to excess; a deformity that marks the beastly vice

inlines.v: GROG, noun A mixture of spirit and water not sweetened. GROG'-BLOSSOM, noun A rum bud; a redness on the nose or face of men who drink ardent spirits to excess; a deformity that marks the beastly vice of intemperance.
